item.title: 5-Drawer Dressers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units; Sold on Amazon by KAIFAM
item.company: Online at Amazon.com from September 2023 through June 2026 for about $180.
item.brand: Online at Amazon.com from September 2023 through June 2026 for about $180.
item.summary: This recall involves KAIFAM 5-Drawer Dressers. The recalled dressers are made of metal and come in white and black. The dressers measure 15.7 inches wide, 31.5 inches long and 53.5 inches tall, and weigh 94.1 pounds. "SKU: N-YSXR0055B" and "Item: Steel Cabinet" are printed on the product packaging.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall and place them in an area that children cannot access. Contact KAIFAM for instructions on how to identify affected units and receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALLED" on the top, front, and sides of the dressers with a permanent marker and remove all five drawers. Consumers will be asked to email photos of the marked and disassembled dressers to KAIFAM_recall@outlook.com to receive a full refund.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
